$comment: P65 [[D-CSUBSET-AUTO-FILE-SCOPE]]: C23 6.7.9 initializer type inference at FILE scope, which DSS refused with error[P_NoAlternativeMatched] because the top-level grammar had no head-less inference form. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-08, each reference probed SEPARATELY: gcc 13.3.0 -std=c2x and clang 18.1.3 -std=c23 each ACCEPT and RUN every declaration here, and `nm` shows `D g` for a plain file-scope `auto` (DEFINED, EXTERNAL) and `d g` for a `static auto` (INTERNAL). MSVC 19.51.36231 ABSTAINS — it accepts the spelling as the C89 storage class over an implicit int (it also accepts `auto g;` and refuses `static auto g = 42;` with C2159), so it is not voting on C23 inference. THE EXAMPLE TESTS MEANING, NOT PARSING: file scope adds LINKAGE and the tentative-definition interaction to the block-scope inference, so it is TWO translation units — def.c's `auto g_ext = 11;` is read here through an ordinary `extern int g_ext;`, which fails the LINK (not the comparison) if the definition is internal or absent; an `auto static` keeps internal linkage; an `auto const` binds its qualifier; an `auto d = 2.0;` must reach codegen as a DOUBLE; and `auto p = "ok";` must DECAY to a pointer and be indexable at runtime. exit = 11 + 20 + 7 + 4 = 42. ⚠ THE SPECIFIERS ARE WRITTEN AFTER `auto` BECAUSE THE FEATURE LANDS `auto`-LED: the head-less top-level rule keeps AutoKeyword out of every other alternative's FIRST so no existing file-scope declaration becomes speculative, and the SPECIFIER-LED spellings (`static auto g = 42;` …) stay refused. `auto static` / `auto const` are equally legal C23 6.7.2p2, accepted by gcc AND clang with identical `nm` linkage, so the CAPABILITY is complete and only the written order is restricted; the specifier-led shape was built and MEASURED breaking a 3000-element file-scope initializer and a 1200-statement `static` function with error[P_SpeculationBudgetExhausted]. RED-ON-DISABLE (REMOVE direction, CONFIG mutant — the mutant is the DOCUMENT, so NO object md5 is involved; what moves is c.lang.json's own md5, which must move and RETURN): delete "autoInferredTopLevelDecl" from `topLevel`'s `alt` list in src/dss-config/sources/c.lang.json — every declaration becomes a loud parse error and the example never links.
